description:
RimSort is an open source mod manager for the video game RimWorld. There is support for Linux, Mac, and Windows, built from the ground up to be a reliable, community-managed alternative to RimPy Mod Manager.


Stable release v1.17.0.
The latest commit is 8ba380d83301e0a6dd26773089956ac8575cf493.

Refer to the [action run](https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/actions/runs/39174532233) that created this release.
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 8ba380d83301e0a6dd26773089956ac8575cf493 -->

## What's Changed
### 🚀 Features and Improvements
• feat：hide satisfied dependencies in Dependency Manager by default by @twstagg in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2536
### 🐛 Bug Fixes
• i18n：complete Brazilian Portuguese interface translations by @Kyo-70 in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2537
### Miscellaneous Changes
• fix：retain InstanceService reference so instance actions stay wired by @twstagg in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2540
• fix：name the missing library when SteamCMD cannot execute on Linux by @twstagg in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2541
• fix：distinguish GitHub rate limits and reuse the user's token in the update check by @twstagg in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2542
• ci：make nix flake check the quality gate and publish a public cachix cache by @twstagg and @Adda0 in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2543
• chore：adapt Qt object lifetimes to PySide6 6.12 and bump the dependency by @twstagg and @Adda0 in https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/pull/2544

• Special thanks to @Adda0 for the assistance given on all of the CI + Nix-related feedback & testing given. Additional thanks for maintaining the downstream nixpkgs package :rocket: 

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/RimSort/RimSort/compare/v1.16.0...v1.17.0
